status: Training, locked evaluation and project molecular predictions complete; see measured performance and limitations
plain_language_purpose: Prioritize DNA changes for laboratory follow-up by predicting whether they change activity in two tested neural cell settings.
not_established: Causal DNA changes, causal genes or treatment targets
A model of older-adult cells or single-cell disease mechanisms
A significant genetic correlation or clinical effect

two_distinct_outputs.overall_assay_call: Ranks the chance that a source-specific laboratory screen detected an effect; surrounding DNA activity strongly influences detection. Scores are uncalibrated.
two_distinct_outputs.active_region_variant_ranking: Ranks effects among source-defined active constructs. A contrast model can expose its conditional expert; other models expose their overall score. This is a harder task and must be evaluated separately.

label_qualification: Siraj is a fixed original source-row activity/skew screen, not the authors final selected best-library list. Nonsignificance is not biological neutrality. Different assays/cells/constructs are not interchangeable.
model_components: Original frozen tiny HyenaDNA sequence representation, previously port-checked; official-runtime executable parity not established
HOCOMOCO human protein DNA-binding models initially fixed; trained heads/contrast trunks learn which patterns predict the laboratory readouts
Physical public bulk DNase/ATAC/footprint profiles in neural cell proxies; missing coordinate mapping differs from absent called peak
AlphaGenome AVI score supplied as an auxiliary target or direct input in explicit paired comparisons

AlphaGenome_usage.kind: Only designated permissive downloadable AVI SNV raw/PHRED artifacts; not detailed API outputs or AVI component breakdowns
AlphaGenome_usage.not_fine_tuned: AlphaGenome itself was not altered. Our own much smaller models were trained.
AlphaGenome_usage.reference_context: AVI describes native GRCh38 context; the experimentally tested constructs can have different native/engineered flanks.

leakage_controls: Source effects/activity and source activity flags are training targets/strata, never prediction inputs
All new supervised fits exclude chromosomes1–3
Extra development folds have exact canonical mutation-containing200bp window leakage audits and hash-verified inputs
Source/reverse-complement equivalence checked for allele contrasts; original genome/foundation training exposures are not independently excluded
Previously queried project-locus neighborhoods removed from the fresh Siraj reserved set

Pre-evaluation refinement excludes355additional Siraj reserved rows within1000bp of either previously analyzed Salomon or Retallick regions, leaving18569strict reserved rows. Original full reserved metrics remain a labelled comparison; no model choices or development fits changed.
evaluation_interpretation: Original chromosomes4–5 and broad development folds are used for optimization/selection, not unbiased nested-CV evidence
Salomon study has previously been used in project development; its chromosome result is not a new independent study
Siraj reserved chromosomes provide an unseen model-performance check within a fixed assay/library; they do not substitute for independent cohorts/donors
AUROC is a ranking measure, not percent-correct accuracy. Average precision must be shown against the positive-call base rate.
Planned genomic-block uncertainty measures within-assay sampling, not all biological/technical uncertainty.
input_requirements: 200- or270-base ACGT reference/alternate DNA strings differing at exactly one position
Caller-verified GRCh38 substitution coordinates and strand, with an explicit studied assay/cell context
Exact audited local AVI row for full model information; unknown rows retain missingness and are imputed using training statistics
Public reference files, fixed encoder, motif files and checkpoint hashes must remain available for the raw-input CLI
implementation_checks: Final27checkpoint/ensemble records checked on development raw-input examples with file hashes, independent CPU/GPU neural arithmetic and conditional-combiner batch/serialization/coefficient checks
Weighted/tied metric and paired genomic-block bootstrap arithmetic checked against scikit-learn
intended_project_use: Hypothesis ranking for insomnia/frailty associated variants. A high molecular score alone does not establish association with either disease.

project_prediction_receipt.training_overlap_caution: Rows explicitly flag exact-substitution and nearby training exposure. None are independent genetic-score validation.
project_prediction_receipt.scores_can_be_compared: Within a fixed role/model and assay context; prevalence/detection differs between studies, so do not rank cell-type relevance from raw between-context values.
project_prediction_receipt.gene_assignment: No causal gene assignment or directional disease-risk inference is made by this score.
project_prediction_receipt.source_provenance: Original UCSC payload and exact target alleles verified in project_input_receipt.json

statistical_caution: Block intervals are descriptive within-assay uncertainty and not adjusted for all comparisons. No independent participant/donor, clinical, causal or original-risk-direction validation.
conditional_stacking_qualification:
Finite development-only combination experiment, no reserved inference.

These are selection-stage development comparisons, not unbiased nested CV:
base checkpoints used their folds for stopping, and other-fold base fits can
have seen the current meta-validation fold. The untouched reserved test is
therefore essential. This limitation must not be hidden by the term OOF.
